pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

findings.what: The third test deletes every row from items. If storage isn't isolated per test, later tests in the file or other files would see an empty table. It is currently the last test in the file.
findings.fix: Confirm the vitest workers pool isolates storage per test, or seed the data inside the test.
